content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers

Stripe’s absence in Kenya means these platforms are useless. Crypto-based solutions like Coinbase Commerce require buyer accounts and KYC, adding friction. No buyer account required. Automatic webhook triggers delivery on payment confirmation. This is infrastructure sovereignty—not a temporary fix.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Platforms like Paddle or Lemon Squeezy claim global reach but fail in Kenya. Their payment processors block transactions from restricted regions. Crypto-only platforms like CoinPayments require buyers to have wallets, limiting your audience. COREMERCH’s architecture removes geographic barriers. NOWPayments accepts payments from anywhere, no buyer account needed. Use BSC, Solana, or TRON networks for fees under $0.10 per transaction. Cloudflare’s global edge network ensures your store loads fast, even in low-bandwidth areas. GitHub Pages and Google Drive are accessible worldwide. Your stack operates independently of regional restrictions. This isn’t localization—it’s globalization without gatekeepers.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this if I’m not technical?
Yes. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes step-by-step blueprints and templates. Deploy in 48 hours with no coding required. GitHub Pages and Google Apps Script are beginner-friendly.
What if NOWPayments blocks my account?
NOWPayments does not require KYC and has no account restrictions. Payments are processed on-chain. Your stack remains operational even if individual services change policies.
How do I handle refunds?
Refunds are processed manually via your crypto wallet. The stack does not automate refunds to maintain simplicity and avoid platform dependencies.
Can I sell physical products?
The stacks are designed for digital products. For physical goods, you’ll need to integrate shipping logic separately. Focus on digital first.
What happens if Cloudflare or GitHub changes policies?
Your stack is deployed on your accounts. If policies change, migrate to alternative services. The architecture is modular and platform-agnostic.
